title: SimBench-BW per-kernel shape file
description: Per-kernel shape declaration at workloads/simbench_bw/shapes/<slug>.toml. Every row declares three distinct shape sets: timing_shapes (for timing), trace_shapes (for NVBit capture), correctness_shapes (for reference comparison). Trace shapes carry a predicted_bytes field enforced against the roster row's trace_budget_mib before any run.

slug.description: Must match the row's slug in roster.toml.

shape_axes.description: Shape-axis map (e.g. {batch: 8, seq: 4096, heads: 32, head_dim: 128}). Keys must be lowercase_identifier. Values are either positive integers or a nested axis-group object whose leaf values are positive integers. Strings, booleans, floats, and unbounded nested structures are rejected so downstream trace_size_estimator and reference-family code can rely on integer-only shape arithmetic.

oneOf.description: Axis group: nested axis map one level deep. Values must be positive integers.

launch_config.description: Launch configuration decomposition used by trace_size_estimator.py for predicted_bytes.

trace_shape_point.description: Trace-mode shape point. predicted_bytes is the trace_size_estimator.py output and must be ≤ trace_budget_mib × 1024 × 1024; shape points that would exceed budget are refused at admission rather than producing a partial trace.

estimator_source.description: Which estimator produced predicted_bytes. static is the default; empirical_calibration means an empirical_calibration_manifest.json overrides the static model for this point.

empirical_calibration_manifest.description: Relative path to the empirical calibration manifest when estimator_source = empirical_calibration.

digest_kind.description: How the correctness output is stored in the golden file. full_tensor: small dense tensor. reduction_summary: scalar / vector statistics (mean, std, max-abs-diff). hash: deterministic hash digest.
